description: The Build orchestrator's step-group settings (step-groups@1, Settings → Plugins → Build orchestrator → Step groups). Stored in pipeline-settings@1 (the dispatcher's settings.json), read and written through GET /api/plugins/build-orchestrator/step-groups/settings and PUT the same (or POST pipeline/settings), MCP orchestrator-groups-settings / orchestrator-groups-settings-set, `pipeline.mjs groups settings [key=value …]`, voice groups.setting:<key>:<value>. Normalised by pipeline-core.mjs normSettings. level = the lowest settings level the row shows at (simple, basic, developer, administrator).

splitOverMin.title: Split builds over (min)
splitOverMin.description: A build whose open steps add up to more than this many minutes is split into step groups that run in parallel slots. 0 = never split. Brett, Nov 16 2026: 30.

maxParallelGroups.title: Max parallel groups per build
maxParallelGroups.description: At most this many groups of one build run at once. Always within the agent cap: every group takes one agent slot.

parallelGroups.title: Parallel groups
parallelGroups.description: On: long builds are split and their groups run side by side. Off: every build runs as one sequential session (a build already split runs one group at a time).
